windows.text: Starting next year, GSK plans to demolish existing buildings and construct new facilities to support clinical and commercial supply. The investment will create more than 300 new jobs over the next five years, Pennsylvania state officials said.

Buildings slated for construction include a biologics production facility to support clinical and commercial supply and a co-located R&D pilot plant “to accelerate tech transfer and process development,” according to the announcement from Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro and Department of Community and Economic Development Secretary Rick Siger. GSK also plans to build a centralized quality control lab and a manufacturing science and technology hub at the site.
